name: timeline_super
description: Build a machine timeline with Plaso: log2timeline over an image, a partition, a directory or a collection, then psort to JSON lines (mode full), or psort alone over a storage file that already exists (mode export, for a new filter without collecting again). What the enabled parsers produced from the sources they could read, not every timestamp on the volume: a parser not enabled, a source not opened and a record not read add no row. Returns the storage file, each stage's exit code, a status (complete: both programs exited 0, wrote their files and every line parsed; partial; failed), the versions the programs print, valid and invalid line counts (a line that is not UTF-8 is invalid, not repaired), the earliest and latest event time, a preview sample and the log and captured-output files. complete is not coverage: the storage file's own processing report (Plaso's pinfo) says what each parser did. Slow by design; give it a narrow parser list when you know what you are after. Refuses an out_dir that already holds files unless resume is true, and then never overwrites what is there. log2timeline and psort run in the tool's own process group (never a session of their own), so the harness ending the tool by its group ends them; on Linux the kernel ends them if the tool dies, the tool's own deadline ends them and what they started, and SIGTERM, SIGINT or SIGHUP do the same and leave a last word (stopped_by_signal, status failed).

out_dir.description: Where the storage file, the output, the logs and the captured output land: a directory under work/<your id>/ (in a job under $OUT, and the default there). New or empty unless resume is true; on resume this run's files are named beside an earlier run's (timeline.2.jsonl), never over them.

source.description: mode full: an image, a partition, a directory or a triage collection

mode.description: full (default: log2timeline then psort) or export (psort only, over storage_file)

storage_file.description: mode export: the existing .plaso file psort reads

parsers.description: Plaso parser filter, e.g. 'winreg,winevtx,prefetch' — far faster than the default; the installed version's help lists the names

timezone.description: The evidence machine's timezone, e.g. 'Europe/Istanbul', for the formats that store local time. Output stays UTC.

psort_filter.description: A psort event filter, e.g. "date > '2026-02-01'"; syntax is the installed psort's

sample.description: How many events to return inline as a preview (default 20, at most 1000)

timeout_seconds.description: One budget for every stage together, from 30 to 3300 (default 1800); the counting of the output has the rest of the tool's own 3600 seconds

resume.description: Allow an out_dir that already holds files; only files written after this run began count as its own
